git commit --amend: We don't amend commits. If needing to change a non-published commit, use `git reset --soft HEAD~1` and recommit. Otherwise, create a new commit with the change.
git push (--force|-f) origin (main|maste: Never force push to main/master. Create a new commit to fix the issue instead.
git reset --hard origin/(main|master): Don't hard reset to remote. Use `git reset --soft` to preserve changes, or `git stash` first.
